sequence: Preserve prepared DNS state; read/revoke saved eight and independently prove withdrawal. Disable original, collect strict native absence, delete/finalize, create/enable new max1 UUID. Fresh normal read/native one-prefix baseline/range/cloud snapshots before one add. Capture actual UPDATE and collect post-limit observer. Restore cloud FIRST using immutable restore-read even if runtime is refused; disable/absence/delete max1, create/enable separate baseline UUID with original limit8. Rebind existing DNS state using restored baseline transition; explicitly recreate DNS4/app2/reverse2; sync-grants then normal fqdn-read. Ambiguous writes reconcile read-only, no blind retries.

dns_saved_binding.rebind: Sets dns-api-setup connection_id/resolver_config_id and lb-api-setup connection_id plus existing fqdn_resource binding to actual new context ID/version/profile/configuration revision/source. Requires actual context replacement/version advancement. Clears old grants and observation caches; retains resource IDs.
dns_saved_binding.sync_grants: Requires exact eight actual new policies and unchanged rebound context; stores their protected_policy_ids in lb-api-setup. Does not create grants.
dns_saved_binding.fqdn_read: Validates restored UUID/config/context binding and protected saved policy IDs, then reads actual existing FQDN resource detail. Returns actual ready/state/status_source/failure_code; no stale readiness inherited or grant automatically created.
dns_saved_binding.blockers: No source binding gap identified. Actual context drift since prepared state, incomplete eight grants, or unavailable fresh generation safely refuses/reports real failure; never overwrite preparation or assume readiness.

validation: All 15 Python sources AST-parsed without execution; all 22 listed files matched exact root HEAD blobs before hashing.
